sms_RED: [AgriQNet ALERT] RED ZONE: {pest} outbreak reported in {district}. Inspect your fields today and contact your Raitha Samparka Kendra.
sms_ORANGE: [AgriQNet WARNING] ORANGE ZONE: {pest} found in neighbouring {reported}. Check your crop and be ready to act.
sms_YELLOW: [AgriQNet ADVISORY] YELLOW ZONE: {pest} reported near {reported}. Keep watching your crop.
wa_veryHeavyRain_advice: Clear field drains, stop fertiliser and pesticide sprays, harvest mature produce and keep it in dry storage.
wa_heavyRain_advice: Open drainage channels and avoid spraying. Support tall crops like banana and sugarcane.
wa_rain_advice: Delay irrigation and plan field work around the showers.
wa_severeHeat_advice: Irrigate in the evening, use mulch, give shade and water to livestock, and avoid field work from 11 am to 4 pm.
wa_heatwave_advice: Give light, frequent irrigation and protect nurseries and young seedlings.
wa_cold_advice: Irrigate lightly in the evening and cover nurseries to reduce cold injury.
wa_damagingWind_advice: Support banana, papaya and sugarcane. Secure polyhouses and do not spray.
wa_strongWind_advice: Postpone spraying and support tall crops.
wa_thunder_advice: Stay away from open fields and trees during lightning, and keep livestock sheltered.
wa_disease_msg: Three or more humid days in a row with mild temperatures.
wa_disease_advice: Watch for paddy blast, late blight and downy mildew. Spray a preventive fungicide if your crop is at risk.
wa_dry_msg: No useful rain in the next 7 days, with hot afternoons.
wa_dry_advice: Plan irrigation; drip or mulching saves 30–40% water. Watch for thrips and mites.
sms_test: AgriQNet test message: SMS alerts are working. You will get pest and weather alerts for your district.
